subject: Post-call: BridgeAI commitment options & startup eligibility
messages:
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta@bridgeai.ai>; Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bridgeai.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps (commit sizing + startup eligibility)

Hi Marta / Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call + a proposed path so we stay aligned: 

1) Your topline ask
- Target workload: ~18M tokens / month (NLP ingestion + multi-turn assistant)
- Target timeline: run in production by Q3 (PO likely in July)
- Constraint: early-stage startup with tight cash runway; looking for a committed discount + startup program credit if eligible

2) Budget / unit-econ target you mentioned
- You said a comfortable spend band is roughly $9k–$13k / month initially (scale as usage stabilizes).
- That implies a target of roughly $500–$725 per 1M tokens at 18M tokens/month.

3) Redwood proposal (prelim, subject to legal/proc sign-off) — see attached preliminary quote
- Committed 12-mo (18M tokens/mo): $550 per 1M tokens -> ~$9,900 / month
- Committed 24-mo (18M tokens/mo): $495 per 1M tokens (additional 10% multi-year incentive) -> ~$8,910 / month
- One-time startup founders credit (if eligible): $5,000 applied to first invoice

4) What we need from you
- Confirm commitment band (18M/mo OK?) and contract length preference (12 vs 24 months)
- Send over the monthly projection spreadsheet (I’ve attached a template if helpful) and procurement contact for PO routing

5) Next week coordination
- Ben (cc’d) will follow up with an updated quote and contract milestone dates once you confirm the commitment band.
- If you want, we can schedule a 30-min procurement/legal intro to align on SOW/PO timing.

Attachments: BridgeAI_Monthly_Projection.xlsx (fill and return), BridgeAI_Prelim_Quote.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on another call to walk through any pieces.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marta Alvarez <marta@bridgeai.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bridgeai.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:33:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps (commit sizing + startup eligibility)

Thanks, Kimberly — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We can commit to 18M tokens / month for 12 months as our baseline. We're open to 24 months if the economics are materially better, but our board prefers an initial 12-mo with an option to extend.
- Our internal budget review suggests we can stretch to ~$11k–$12k / month for the first 3 months while we validate the feature. So your $9.9k quote for 12-mo committed looks within reach.
- Startup eligibility: we are a seed-stage company (YC W23), under $1.5M ARR. We'd like to understand what documentation you need for the founders credit and any program limits.

Procurement: Liam is our finance lead (cc’d) and will own PO + vendor setup. He prefers to get an itemized quote that shows monthly committed token bands and the startup credit applied.

Next step: can Ben send an itemized quote that shows the 12-mo and 24-mo math side-by-side and an example first invoice with the $5k credit applied? Also please send the startup intake form.

Appreciate it —
Marta
Co-founder & Head of Product
BridgeAI

Hi Marta / Liam —

Thanks for confirming the 18M / month baseline. Per Kim's note, I’ve put together an itemized, line-by-line comparison in the attached PDF (BridgeAI_Prelim_Quote.pdf). Key takeaways here in plain terms: 

- List price (hosted generation): $1,000 per 1M tokens (for reference only).
- Committed 12-month (18M/mo): $550 per 1M => $9,900 / month.
- Committed 24-month (18M/mo): $495 per 1M => $8,910 / month (applies an additional 10% multi-year incentive).
- Optional burst / overage band (if you spike above committed): billed at $750 per 1M until next billing tier is reached.

Startup program specifics (what we typically require):
- Eligibility: < $5M ARR, less than 36 months since founding, or YC/other accelerator proof.
- Docs: short intake form (attached), founder/board proof (simple), and a brief call with our startup program manager.
- Benefit: $5k one-time credit + priority onboarding + access to a developer resource pack.

Procurement items we need to accelerate contract:
- Legal contact for redlines, PO contact for invoicing, expected effective date, and billing entity details.

If that all looks good, I’ll ask Sales Ops to draft a standard 12-mo commitment quote showing the $5k credit applied to the first invoice and a version for 24 months. We can also include a 30-day early-termination clause for the first 60 days of production as a one-time concession for startups.

Would you like me to include an example P&L impact showing cost per 1M token and monthly spend for easy review by your CFO?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

P.S. Vivek — looping you for any flexibility on incremental rebates or founder-credit exceptions.

Thanks team — quick internal note on approvals and program flexibility.

- For seed-stage startups we can generally approve the $5k founders credit and the standard 10% multi-year incentive at the AE level. Anything beyond that (extra one-time credits, deeper per-1M reductions below $480) requires Sales Ops + RevOps approval.
- If BridgeAI is open to a 12-month commitment with a Q2 start date (July effective), we can fast-track the quote and include the founders credit on invoice #1.
- Required intake items: completed Startup Intake Form, a copy of the accelerator acceptance (if applicable), and billing entity details. I’ve attached the intake form for your convenience.

Ben — please prepare two quotes (12mo and 24mo) with an explicit first-invoice example showing the $5k credit applied. I’ll flag the opportunity in our pipeline and make sure Sales Ops watches for the PO.

Marta/Liam — let me know if you want a short call with RevOps to walk through tax/PO timing and sample invoices.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

If you can get the two quotes (12mo / 24mo) to me by Thursday morning, I’ll route the PO and aim to have vendor setup complete by the following week.
